cohort: A total of 1088 offspring born to pregnant women with gestational diabetes (GD) who completed gestation after being recruited from primary care centres and maternity hospitals in Argentina.
finding: Offspring of women with GD presented macrosomia in 12.9% of cases, with maternal history of dyslipidaemia and macrosomia in previous pregnancies being early predictors, while a combination of maternal obesity, FBG, and hypertriglyceridemia became significant during the last trimester.
birth_weight: Macrosomic newborns (birth weight > 4000g) were identified as an outcome.
